claim_text: 88% of total water was reused across TSF and Project sites
context_text:
In FY25, Ora Banda is proud to have reused 1,249,748 kL (88 per cent of total water usage in FY26) of water across the TSF and Project sites.
[table]Figure 7 Amount of water consumed across Ora Banda’s project sites:609,133 kL (Water Abstraction), 796,403 kL (Dewater Water Consumption Method), and 3,330 kL (Imported water), implying total water usage of 1,408,866 kL.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: The report states that 1,249,748 kL of water was reused, and Figure 7 implies total FY25 water usage of 1,408,866 kL. This yields about 88.7%, which supports the 88% claim.
llm_reason: The central assertion is a quantified outcome: that 88% of total water was reused across TSF and Project sites. No evidence fields were provided to substantiate any water reuse percentage, the definition of “total water,” the reuse calculation, or the scope/timeframe for TSF and Project sites. As a result, the specific 88% figure and the claimed reuse outcome are not verified by the provided evidence.
